# CNBC

> CNBC is the world's leading source for real-time financial market coverage, business news, and in-depth analysis of stocks, commodities, economics, and emerging industries.

CNBC provides comprehensive coverage of global markets, corporate earnings, economic policy, and industry-specific news across finance, healthcare, energy, technology, and transportation sectors. The site combines breaking news with investigative journalism and detailed market analysis for investors and business professionals.

## Key Topics

- Stock Markets & Indexes
- Financial Earnings & Analysis
- Federal Reserve & Monetary Policy
- Commodities & Energy Crisis
- AI Technology & ChatGPT
- Electric Vehicles & Transportation
- Pharmaceutical & FDA Approvals
- Market Overview & Bonds
- Geopolitical News
- Business M&A & Corporate News
- Real Estate & Housing Markets
- Climate & Clean Energy
- Regulatory Approval
- Retail Innovation
- Investigative Journalism

## Markets & Financial Data

- [Markets: Indexes, Bonds, Forex, Key Commodities, ETFs](https://www.cnbc.com/markets): Markets overview with S&P, NASDAQ, DOW indexes, bonds, forex, commodities, ETFs
- [Stock Markets, Business News, Financials, Earnings - CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com): CNBC homepage: world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage

## Business & Finance News

- [Business News](https://www.cnbc.com/business): Business news headlines covering corporate mergers, earnings, and consumer trends
- [Finance News](https://www.cnbc.com/finance): Wall Street finance news covering stocks, trading, Fed policy, and market analysis
- [Economic News](https://www.cnbc.com/economy): Economic news on Fed rates, inflation, trade tariffs, and GDP growth

## Industry Coverage

- [Healthcare & Science News](https://www.cnbc.com/health-and-science): Healthcare news on pharmaceutical drugs, FDA approvals, and obesity treatments
- [Energy News](https://www.cnbc.com/energy): Energy market news on oil, gas, geopolitical impacts, and commodity prices
- [Transportation News: Airlines, Autos, Roads and Rails - CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/transportation): Transportation industry news on airlines, autos, EVs, and logistics
- [Real Estate News](https://www.cnbc.com/real-estate): Real estate news covering housing markets, mortgages, and commercial property
- [Media News](https://www.cnbc.com/media): Media industry news on M&A, streaming, broadcasting, and AI advertising

## Emerging Topics

- [Climate Change and Environment News](https://www.cnbc.com/climate): Climate and environment news covering clean energy, ESG, and tech sustainability
- [Prediction Markets](https://www.cnbc.com/prediction-markets): News and insights on prediction markets including Polymarket and Kalshi

## Investigative Journalism

- [CNBC Investigations](https://www.cnbc.com/cnbc-investigations): In-depth investigative journalism on fraud, supply chain, and corporate accountability
